tool.name: nf-core peka
tool.description: Runs PEKA CLIP peak k-mer analysis
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ # If the modification date and time of the fai is before the fasta then # there will be an error. Touching the file first avoids that. touch $fai mkdir tmp TMPDIR=\$(pwd)/tmp peka \ -i $peaks \ -x $crosslinks \ -g $fasta \ -gi $fai \ -r $gtf \ $args
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": peka: $VERSION END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Runs PEKA CLIP peak k-mer analysis
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: peka Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/peka ]]>
